title: G06: implementation-planning gate contract (work-breakdown / test-plan / release-plan / rollback-plan)
objective: Enforce Gate 06, declared in lifecycle.json but unbacked: give its four required_evidence types per-type rules in validate_evidence, exactly as G01-G05, so the gate OPENS each artifact. work-breakdown -- non-empty bounded tasks with a resolvable acyclic dependency graph (work packages bounded + composition order defined). test-plan -- non-empty planned tests, each naming what it verifies. release-plan -- non-empty environments and concrete steps. rollback-plan -- an executable method + steps + non-empty stop_conditions. Ship examples/gate-dossier.G06.json (C1, validated in CI) and prove an instance advances G05->G06 on a valid G06 dossier.
business_value: Without per-type rules a G06 dossier passes on names alone. This makes the four implementation-planning exit criteria -- work bounded, composition order defined, environments/resources ready, rollback+stop-conditions executable -- deterministic gate refusals. Continues the gate march (G00-G06 now enforced) with the same lean substrate as G01-G05, no new module.
in_scope: check_work_breakdown / check_test_plan / check_release_plan / check_rollback_plan in badf_gate.py + registration in EVIDENCE_RULES
examples/gate-dossier.G06.json (C1, engineering_owner + independent_reviewer) + its four evidence/artifact pairs; CI validates it
tests/test_badf_g06.py (failing-first refusals) + a G05->G06 pair-acceptance in tests/test_badf_advance.py
own G07 self-dossier; doctrine section in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md
out_of_scope: a badf-planning authoring skill (a later WP if a real task needs it)
later gates G07+ -- one WP each; any change to G06 authority
acceptance_criteria: an empty/dangling/cyclic work-breakdown, a test-plan test that verifies nothing, a release-plan with no environments or steps, and a rollback-plan with no method or no stop_conditions are each refused
an instance at G05/APPROVED advances to G06/APPROVED on a valid G06 dossier
each check branch is load-bearing (mutation/in-process verified); compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Reuses the G01-G05 substrate -- no new validator module. G06 min change class is C1, so the example dossier carries the two base roles (engineering_owner + independent_reviewer). Shipped via the operator's /loop self-paced gate march. Resolves #125 / GOV-0046. Reconciles WP-2026-0066.
